authorization.quote: Arc plan + adaptation decisions must be inputs before the per-episode layers are built, review revisions must be reflected in the final sealed narrative and downstream contract (sha binding). Reuse existing ledgers/knowledge/previs. Wire behind a policy profile/flag so already-sealed episodes (E01-E13, LEGACY) are unaffected and E14+ use it.
authorization.quote_followup_2026_11_01: Line owner 2026-11-01 follow-up: required as a STEP (the script cannot be marked complete for paid prep without a completed review and the writer's answers to every question; Rule 8 must carry a grounded answer or a NOT_APPLICABLE reason). Creative judgement stays REPORT-ONLY: an AI opinion that a hook is weak, the pace slow or the emotion thin is a revision note in E14, never an automatic veto by score or a single judgement. Cross-shot detections are OBSERVE-ONLY in E14: record evidence, confidence and disposition to learn the false-positive rate; they do not block, and a clearly confirmed serious problem is still handled while an uncertain one is never recorded as a pass.

LEGACY.applies_to: every episode sealed before this capability existed
LEGACY.behaviour: byte-identical to before; nothing new is required, nothing new is checked
LEGACY.note: the sealed list is a record, not a gate: an episode named here is never re-judged

WRITER_CAPABILITY_V1.behaviour: arc ledger, adaptation dispositions, script review and the Rule 8 response are required inputs to S1; the sealed narrative must carry the sha the review was given

blocking.step_effect: a missing arc ledger / adaptation disposition / Rule 8 grounded answer, or a script review the writer has not answered, prevents the script being marked complete and entering paid preparation; it never refuses on opinion
blocking.creative_judgement_policy: REPORT_ONLY_IN_E14: hook strength, pace and emotion are revision notes (a finding the writer may accept or answer), never a score gate and never an automatic veto
blocking.note: The step requirement is per episode and per input; it adds no batch step and no serialisation of unit work.

sealed_binding.rule: the narrative the review read must be the narrative that is sealed; the receipt carries the narrative sha256 the review was bound to, and S1 compares
